# netcup_user_logs (Data Source)

The logs of the netcup SCP user of the refresh token (SCP REST API).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netcup_user_logs" "example" {
  limit = 50
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `limit` (Number) Maximum number of entries. Reads all entries if unset.
- `offset` (Number) Number of entries to skip.

### Read-Only

- `logs` (Attributes List) Log entries of the user. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--logs))

<a id="nestedatt--logs"></a>
### Nested Schema for `logs`

Read-Only:

- `date` (String) Time of the entry.
- `executing_user` (Attributes) User who executed it. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--logs--executing_user))
- `log_key` (String) Key of the entry.
- `message` (String) Message of the entry.
- `type` (String) `ERROR`, `WARNING` or `INFO`.

<a id="nestedatt--logs--executing_user"></a>
### Nested Schema for `logs.executing_user`

Read-Only:

- `company` (String) Company.
- `email` (String) E-mail address.
- `firstname` (String) First name.
- `id` (Number) Id of the user.
- `lastname` (String) Last name.
- `username` (String) User name.
